例如：从主仓库调 20 件到门店: e.g. move 20 items from the main warehouse to the shop
数量需为 1 以上的整数: Quantity must be a whole number of 1 or more
「{{v0}}」调出仓库只有 {{v1}} {{v2}}，不够调拨: Only {{v1}} {{v2}} of “{{v0}}” in the source warehouse — not enough to transfer

没有可以调入的仓库: No warehouse can receive the transfer
确认后立即生效：调出仓库减少、调入仓库增加，总库存不变。: Takes effect immediately: the source warehouse decreases, the destination increases, total stock stays the same.
有门店、仓库、档口等多个放货的地方时，可以分开记录库存并互相调拨。只有一个仓库时: If you keep goods in several places — a shop, a warehouse, a market stall — track stock separately and transfer between them. With only one warehouse, other pages don't show warehouse choices.
多仓库是专业版功能: Multiple warehouses are a Pro feature

专业版到期期间，主仓库照常使用；其他仓库只能把库存调拨出去，续费后恢复。: While Pro has expired, the main warehouse works as usual; other warehouses can only transfer stock out until you renew.
已达上限，可停用不用的仓库: Limit reached — deactivate a warehouse you no longer use
停用后不能再在这个仓库开单、入库或调入；历史记录保留。仓库里还有库存时不能停用，: You won't be able to sell, stock in or transfer into this warehouse; history is kept. A warehouse with stock can't be deactivated — transfer it out or count it to 0 first.
例如：门店、东区仓库、批发市场档口: e.g. Shop, East warehouse, Market stall
